-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [Paqueteria] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_Paqueteria_Index]
@Comunidad_Id AS INT = 0,
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@TipoPaquete_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Carrier_Id AS INT = 0, 
@EstatusPaqueteria_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @PaqueteriaFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		Paqueteria_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @PaqueteriaFilter (Paqueteria_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Paqueteria].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Paqueteria]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[Paqueteria].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @PaqueteriaFilter (Paqueteria_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Paqueteria].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Paqueteria] 
		LEFT JOIN [Membresia] ON [Paqueteria].[Membresia_Id] = [Membresia].[Id] 
		WHERE
			 [Paqueteria].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([Paqueteria].[EstatusPaqueteria_Id] = @EstatusPaqueteria_Id) OR (@EstatusPaqueteria_Id = 0)) AND
         (([Paqueteria].[TipoPaquete_Id] = @TipoPaquete_Id) OR (@TipoPaquete_Id = 0)) AND
         (([Paqueteria].[Carrier_Id] = @Carrier_Id) OR (@Carrier_Id = 0)) AND
         (([Membresia].[Comunidad_Id] = @Comunidad_Id) OR (@Comunidad_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[Paqueteria].[Id],
		[Paqueteria].[Membresia_Id],
		[Paqueteria].[TipoPaquete_Id],
		[Paqueteria].[Guia],
		[Paqueteria].[Carrier_Id],
		[Paqueteria].[Suscriptor_Id],
		[Paqueteria].[Fecha],
		[EntregaPaqueteria].[FechaEntrega],
		[Usuario].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Usuario].ApellidoPaterno + ' '+ [Usuario].ApellidoMaterno AS EntregadoPor,
		[Paqueteria].[Activo],
		[Paqueteria].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[Paqueteria].[DesactivadoPor],
		[Membresia].[ClaveMembresia] + ' - ' + [dbo].[InformacionFacturacion].[NombreFiscal]  AS [MembresiaClaveMembresia],
		[Comunidad].[Nombre] AS Sucursal,
		[TipoPaquete].[Nombre] AS [TipoPaqueteNombre],
		[EstatusPaqueteria].[Nombre] AS [EstatusPaqueteria],
		[TipoPaquete].[Descripcion] AS [TipoPaqueteDescripcion],
		[Carrier].[Nombre] AS [CarrierNombre],
		[Carrier].[Descripcion] AS [CarrierDescripcion],
		[Suscriptor].[Nombre] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoPaterno] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoMaterno] + ' (' + [Suscriptor].[CorreoElectronico] + ')' AS [SuscriptorCorreoElectronico],
		[Suscriptor].[Nombre] AS [SuscriptorNombre],
		[Paqueteria].[FechaCreacion],
		[Paqueteria].[CreadoPor],
		[Paqueteria].[FechaModificacion],
		[Paqueteria].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @PaqueteriaFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[Paqueteria] 
			ON [Paqueteria].[Id] = filter.[Paqueteria_Id] 
			
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Membresia]
		ON [dbo].[Paqueteria].[Membresia_Id] = [dbo].[Membresia].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[TipoPaquete]
		ON [dbo].[Paqueteria].[TipoPaquete_Id] = [dbo].[TipoPaquete].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Carrier]
		ON [dbo].[Paqueteria].[Carrier_Id] = [dbo].[Carrier].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Suscriptor]
		ON [dbo].[Paqueteria].[Suscriptor_Id] = [dbo].[Suscriptor].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[InformacionFacturacion]
		ON [dbo].[Membresia].[InformacionFacturacion_Id] = [dbo].[InformacionFacturacion].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Comunidad]
		ON [dbo].[Membresia].[Comunidad_Id] = [dbo].[Comunidad].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[EstatusPaqueteria]
		ON [dbo].[Paqueteria].[EstatusPaqueteria_Id] = [dbo].[EstatusPaqueteria].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria]
		ON [dbo].[Paqueteria].[Id] = [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria].[Paqueteria_Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Usuario]
		ON [dbo].[EntregaPaqueteria].[Usuario_Id] = [Usuario].[Id] 

		ORDER BY [Paqueteria].[FechaCreacion] 
END
-- END OF [dbo].[cgp_Paqueteria_Index]
Name: rpt_Paqueteria_Index
